'''Sathiemon''' was an [[Temperature/Legends|arid]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], where [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]] by a hit squad during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], while the latter was hunting a bounty. Sathiemon had numerous holes and burrows, that the natives used.<ref name="BT5" />
